method.EXECUTED_PASS: At least one concrete automated test, or a complementary set of automated tests, directly exercises every material invariant and forbidden outcome in the synthetic offline scenario.
method.PARTIAL: Automated evidence directly exercises part of the scenario, but one or more material invariants, negative outcomes, candidate-package boundaries, or visual/live assertions remain untested.
method.NOT_EXECUTED: No automated test directly executes the scenario's material behavior; schema presence, instruction text, or inference from implementation is not execution evidence.
method.frozen_package_rule: A test that only executes frozen RC2 or 1.1.0 archives cannot by itself establish 1.2.0 candidate behavior.
method.review_posture: Skeptical; specification-only cases are not promoted to PASS by inference.

overall_claim: PARTIAL_BEHAVIORAL_COVERAGE_ONLY; this record does not establish that all catalog objectives are met.
